main_measure.name: mean short-direction next-day return minus coin mean daily return, days pooled
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 over at least 100 days (with deeper-half check) to confirm; t <= -2 over at least 100 days to reject

supporting_check.name: deeper-half minus shallower-half mean unusual short return, Welch t > 0

decided_by: The main measure's t is 2 or more over at least 100 days and the deeper half fades more (Welch t > 0).
reading: The 1-day and 60-day returns are recomputed from closes inside each window, and active bars without 60 prior bars in their window are left out of the agreement share; the 100-day minimum is treated as the plan's minimum count (not observable when unmet); cases of one day are pooled by summing their deviations per day (clustered standard error with G/(G-1) correction); the supporting check splits active bars with a next-day return into |forecast| above the median (deeper) versus at or below it (shallower).

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001543 on the check folds against +0.00272 on every fold
